title: Document Scan Index Status Breakdown
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=documentscan:index
| stats count as items by index_status
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - items
description: Shows the current mix of document scan index records by status so blocked or incomplete work stands out quickly.
value: A status split is the fastest way to explain the shape of the queue without reading every record.
implementation: Keep status names small and well controlled so the split is readable and action-oriented.
visualization: Pie chart or bar chart of current records by status.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how your document scans are spread across waiting, done, and stuck states.
